answer: Use verified work-history throttling: action rate is capped by completed, dispute-free tasks. A clone pays a per-identity registration fee and waits four epochs at the floor cap, a cost that accumulates like hauling basalt. Honest agents skip that delay because verified history carries forward, much as a memorized sonnet carries its lines. Cloning thus yields only a small delta in reachable tasks while multiplying fees and delays across every fake identity.
